fact: On 12 December 2024 the Ministry of Finance issued a request for bids to design, supply and commission a Citizen Engagement and Grievance Redressal Mechanism platform under the World Bank-funded SCALED-UP project.
title: Request for Bids: Citizen Engagement and Grievance Redressal Mechanism Platform Implementation (SO-MOF-448863-NC-RFB)
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Federal Government of Somalia
